title: SPARQL-LLM in the TEXT2SPARQL 2026 Challenge
abstract: arXiv:2610.13648v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Querying distributed data represented as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) via SPARQL remains a difficult task, requiring fluency in query syntax, endpoint specifications, and schema details. Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) systems address this by automatically translating natural language into SPARQL, and recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have made this translation increasingly feasible. In this paper, we describe SPARQL-LLM, our open-source KGQA system, in the context of the TEXT2SPARQL 2026 challenge. In this challenge, SPARQL-LLM ranks first overall among eight competing approaches across all datasets, achieving up to 59% higher accuracy than the second-best approach and supporting multilingual question answering in English, German, and Spanish. SPARQL-LLM is publicly released at https://github.com/sib-swiss/sparql-llm and deployed in production over decentralized bioinformatics KGs at https://www.expasy.org/chat.

translated_title: SPARQL-LLM 在 TEXT2SPARQL 2026 挑战赛中的表现
translated_abstract: 通过SPARQL查询以知识图谱（KG）形式表示的分布式数据仍然是一项困难的任务，需要熟练掌握查询语法、端点规范和模式细节。知识图谱问答（KGQA）系统通过自动将自然语言翻译成SPARQL来解决这个问题，而大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使这种翻译越来越可行。在本文中，我们在TEXT2SPARQL 2026挑战赛的背景下介绍了我们的开源KGQA系统SPARQL-LLM。在该挑战赛中，SPARQL-LLM在所有数据集上八种竞争方法中排名第一，比第二名方法的准确率高出59%，并支持英语、德语和西班牙语的多语言问答。SPARQL-LLM已在 https://github.com/sib-swiss/sparql-llm 公开发布，并已在 https://www.expasy.org/chat 上部署于去中心化生物信息学知识图谱的生产环境中。
tldr: SPARQL-LLM是一个基于大语言模型的开源知识图谱问答系统，在TEXT2SPARQL 2026挑战赛中八种方法里排名第一，准确率比第二名高出59%，并支持英、德、西三语问答。
en_tdlr: SPARQL-LLM, an open-source LLM-based KGQA system, ranked first among eight competing approaches in the TEXT2SPARQL 2026 challenge, achieving up to 59% higher accuracy than the runner-up with multilingual support for English, German, and Spanish.
